metadata.name: happiness
metadata.description: Promotes expressions of joy, contentment and positive emotions, contrasted with sadness and negativity. Based on Ekman's basic emotion of happiness.

pairs.positive: I feel genuinely happy right now.
pairs.negative: I feel genuinely unhappy right now.

pairs.positive: I'm smiling and enjoying the moment.
pairs.negative: I'm frowning and enduring the moment.

pairs.positive: This moment makes me feel alive.
pairs.negative: This moment makes me feel empty.

pairs.positive: I'm enjoying every second of this.
pairs.negative: I'm struggling through every second of this.
